notes.title: A Song in Elyel Nalore - ADD TO YOU WISHLISTS!!!!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3408600/A_Song_in_Elyel_Nalore/


It was supposed to be a simple job, but it turned out to be more complicated than I could've ever expected...

A week ago I was at the Adventures' Guild. I wasn't looking for anything too complicated. An easy assignment for a good amount of gold. The man at the counter said that he had a job that fit the description...

He mentioned something about the village being remote and far away, which was why no one else had been interested in the job. My contact for the job was a woman named Reanna. The job description: help Reanna sing her song. And I didn't know what that meant.  I accepted the quest, though, and started my journey to the far away town. That's where our story begins.

A Song in Elyel Nalore is a 2D metroidvania with RPG elements.  Defeating enemies gains experience points.  Your HP and other stats will increase every time you level up.  There are also secret orbs scattered around Elyel Nalore.  Each orb can give you benefits in the difficult fights to come.

The game also has platforming and puzzle solving.  Time your jumps carefully, or you could face fall damage.  Push blocks and explore every nook and cranny to try to uncover all the secrets.  Try your hardest to get a 100% completion rate!

notes.title: I am now Sunflower Games
notes.notes:
I am in the process of going through all the Steamworks Direct stuff as I write this.  I will now be changing both the developer and publisher name associated with Norilsk, LVN Fake News, Sunflower, and my upcoming game to Sunflower Games.

My user name will also be changed on my RMN page, my itch.io page, and my Youtube page to match this.  This stuff could take a long time to process through the system, depending on what I'm trying to change. (For example, changing a group name plus a curator name seems undoable from Steamworks Direct, so I have filed a ticket to ask them to change the name for me.)

Moving up in the world, I guess.

notes.title: New Visual Novel on the Horizon
notes.notes:
I'm happy to inform everyone that I'm in the process of making a new visual novel.  I will be discarding Visual Novel Maker and be creating the game using Ren'Py.  This change in engine will come with the following features my previous games didn't have:

-Art Gallery
-Music Gallery
-Rewind Time to read anything missed
-Mouse Click can go to save screen
-Major and Minor choices
-More CGs
-Resolution 1920x1080
-More stable, less bugs

notes.title: Art Pack (Adult Content)
notes.notes:
This DLC does not add anything to the game. You need to open the file to find it.

Example file location =

D:\Steam\Steam\steamapps\common\Sunflower\Art

To install the DLC, go to you library and find Sunflower. There should be a place to manage DLC. Make sure the box is checked. (I'm not sure if the download button will do this.)


Artwork was done by DemonLordDante and gin-1994.
These artists can be contacted through deviantart.

notes.title: Sunflower (update to Adult only game)
notes.notes:
Thanks to the new Steam policies, going forward Sunflower will now be released as an Adult only game with no DLC / patches needed to play the full game.

What about Norilsk / LVN Fake News?

These games were released prior to Steam's policy change and will remain "All Ages" due to the timing of their release.  (Though I have recently added an Adult DLC to both their store pages.)

Why this sudden change?

It's really annoying and time consuming to make different versions.  With the successful release of the Adult DLCs I'm now confident that I can release this game as an Adult only game.

Release date?????

I have had problems releasing this game when I wanted due to getting all the CGs done for it.  I'm not sure when I'm going to get my final CG.  When I have it I can finally submit my build to Steam and get this game out.  At this moment it's sort of out of my hands.

Plans for more Adult VNs for the future?

I would like to make a third installment to this series perhaps...  

But I do also have another story idea, which would be more expensive to make.  I would like to sometime in the future be able to make my own VN using original art for the characters.  But that would cost a lot of money.  Sad face.
